afterApplying.title: Follow-up after applying
afterApplying.desc: Use this when you want to message the company's recruiter on LinkedIn right after submitting your application.
afterApplying.text:
Hi [Recruiter Name],

I applied for the [Position] role at [Company] earlier today. With more than four years of frontend experience I would be glad to contribute to the team, and I am happy to share more detail on any part of my background here.

Have a good day!

Best regards,
[Your Name]

afterInterview.title: Thank-you note after an interview
afterInterview.desc: Send it within 24 hours of the interview to confirm your interest while the conversation is still fresh.
afterInterview.text:
Hi [Interviewer Name],

Thank you for your time today and for the conversation about the [Position] role. I especially liked what you described about the direction of the product and the way the team approaches technical decisions.

I am looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
